content:
The image shows a mango leaf with white/pale powdery patches distributed across the upper surface. The spots are irregular, whitish-grey, and have a dusty/powdery appearance. There's no black sooty encrustation, no brown sunken lesions, and no bark/twig involvement.

This matches Powdery Mildew: white powdery fungal growth on leaf surface.
